thread:
rashid: Heads up — sustained latency SLO misses in us-west2 for the last ~20m. p95 jumped 180ms -> 420ms. Dash: https://dash/reports/abc :eyes:

mike: Any obvious spike in qlen or batch sizes?

rashid: qlen is up. Batcher metrics show mode ~2 but tail hitting the max-batch cap frequently. Admission is waiting for full batches, so small requests pile up and GPU queues are saturated. Also seeing prefill eviction storms.

anna: `batch_size_histogram` + `gpu_queue_length` traces? can you paste a snippet?

rashid: pasted small excerpt from logs:
```
batch_size_histogram: mode=2, 90p=16, 99p=120
gpu_queue_length:  avg=42, p95=96
admission_wait_ms: median=12, p95=380
```

sophie: Did we roll anything last night that could change packing behavior?

mike: Kernel tweak was only on eu cluster, not us-west. packing logic unchanged.

ops-oncall: Oncall here — I briefly increased admission throttle to lower queue depth. qlen dropped ~15% but cost jumped. That was a temporary patch.

rashid: Bump helped a bit but SLO still failing. Root seems to be continuous high-throughput of tiny requests; the max_batch cap (128) makes admission try to fill big batches and delays dispatch. When packer hits those tails, KV prefill churn causes stalls.

serena: We should consider short-term and long-term: short-term = favor small requests and prefilled requests in admission. Long-term = adaptive max-batch that depends on seq-length distribution + prioritization lanes.

anna: Quick experiment idea: dynamic max_batch = min(global_max, 8 + 2*sqrt(active_small_reqs)). Low cost to prototype on canaries.

mike: Or add a priority class: latency-priority for reqs with tokens < 64, prefill=false. Admission picks from that queue first.

rashid: I'll spin up an A/B on 10 canary GPUs and bias admission to prefer small-reqs. Also will add a short TTL on prefill eviction to avoid thrash. Need capacity approval to add 4 more nodes to us-west2 for the test (1h).

ops-oncall: Request submitted to autoscale with `expedite=true`.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2027 — Continuous batching pressure causing latency SLO misses in us-west2. Runbook link: https://runbooks/inc-2027

serena: SDK change we discussed earlier could help: return 429 with `Retry-After` when server-side queueing > threshold. That would give clients backpressure instead of piling on. I'll draft the API error semantics.

rashid: Thanks. Plan for next 60m: 1) deploy small-req bias to canaries, 2) enable short prefill eviction TTL, 3) monitor p95/p99 and cost. If canary looks good, roll to 30% and keep autoscale buffer.

anna: I'll open a PR for the admission rule and the experiment config. tagging @mike for review. :thumbsup:

mike: Reviewing now. If we see improvement, follow up with a longer design doc for adaptive max-batch and QoS lanes.

ops-oncall: Keeping oncall looped; will escalate to infra if queueing returns.
